description: The reasoning-effort pills select a level, persist it, and keep the popover open. The screen is the default phone. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". The pills are the panel's ".model-picker-effort-pill" elements. 1. Navigate to /new, remove localStorage "shelley.thinkingLevel.v2", and reload by navigating to /new again. 2. Open the model picker; the panel should be visible. 3. There should be at least 6 pills, and none whose text is exactly "max" (models without capability metadata get the standard levels through xhigh). 4. Click the pill whose text is exactly "high". 5. The panel should still be visible, localStorage "shelley.thinkingLevel.v2" must be exactly "high", and that pill should have aria-checked="true". 6. Press Escape: the panel should be hidden. 7. Reload by navigating to /new again and open the model picker. 8. The panel's element with role "radio" and accessible name exactly "high" should have aria-checked="true".
